_help: Clan life's settings. enabled: the Clans (false: none, even while you play a Sandbox mode cat). day_minutes: how many real minutes a day lasts (20 is the game's own). night_sky: the sky follows the clock, dark at night. cats_in_world: at most how many of a camp's cats are in the world at once (5 to 50), the nearest to your cat first. cats_within_m: a cat whose place is farther from your cat than this (metres, 10 to 100) is kept as data, out of the world, its day going on. days_per_moon: how many days by the clock make a moon (1: a kit is apprenticed after six days). party_size: how many clanmates can come with you (1 to 5).
